acceptanceCriteria: A test with a label override and a held ticket absent from the observation shows the specified effective limit, or the spec records the key-only rule as intended.
body: Residual from V1-1647 (PR #1085, ATR-V0-087 and the spec failure-modes row). Expected: a budget hold for a ticket the observation no longer supplies resolves its effective limit using label/kind overrides as well. Actual: it resolves by ticket key alone, so only a ticket-selector override applies. Suspected impact, not reproduced end-to-end.

completion.reason: Delivered on origin/main 2b0cfce94; every acceptance criterion re-verified read-only in the pre-1.0 sweep. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-20-pre-1-0-sweep-delivered-closures.md (decision 0547).

title: budget hold for an unobserved ticket ignores label/kind overrides
